draft.exec:
You run your applications on AWS but must keep database records in Jakarta to meet data residency rules.

This proposal places a managed MySQL instance in Alibaba Cloud Jakarta and links it to your AWS servers over a dedicated private connection.

Your data stays in the required region while your existing AWS applications continue operating without migration.

needs.need: Database records must remain in Jakarta to satisfy data residency requirements.
needs.answer: ApsaraDB RDS stores the MySQL data in the Jakarta region across two zones. Your applications stay on AWS while the data meets local placement rules.

needs.need: AWS application servers must reach the Jakarta database securely and reliably.
needs.answer: Express Connect provides a dedicated private link between AWS and the Jakarta VPC. This keeps database traffic off the public internet, reducing exposure to interception.

outcomes.title: Data residency met without app migration
outcomes.text: The design places only the database in Jakarta. Your team avoids rewriting or moving the existing AWS applications, saving migration effort and keeping current operations running.

outcomes.title: Private cross-cloud database access
outcomes.text: A dedicated physical line carries MySQL traffic between AWS and Alibaba Cloud. This reduces the risk of exposing database queries to the public internet.

outcomes.title: Database availability across two zones
outcomes.text: The managed MySQL runs in Jakarta zones A and B. If one zone fails, the database remains available, reducing the chance of application outages.

why.rds: Keeps your MySQL data in Jakarta to satisfy data residency rules while removing the burden of managing database servers yourself. Without it, you would need to build and maintain a custom database setup in the region.
why.express-connect: Provides a stable, private path for your AWS applications to query the Jakarta database, avoiding public internet risks. Without it, you would rely on less predictable connections that increase exposure and latency.

tradeoffs.text: Express Connect bandwidth pricing depends on the steady traffic volume between AWS and Jakarta.
tradeoffs.mitigation: Answer the open question on traffic volume (under 1 Gbps, 1-10 Gbps, or over 10 Gbps) to finalize costs.

next: Confirm the steady traffic volume between AWS and Jakarta to size the Express Connect link.
Validate that this architecture satisfies your specific data residency obligations with your compliance team.
Review the catalog pricing for ApsaraDB RDS and Express Connect attached below.
